notes: Read by an external reader (Meta Muse) from a written spec (/mnt/project-files/muse-permit-appeals/prompt.md) over the volume's Internet Archive OCR text, minutesofmeeting1982sanf; converted here, page-located in the hOCR, quotations and street numbers checked against the OCR, and resolved here. Personal names were removed from every field on conversion.

coverage.remaining: Not in the scan or not read: October 6, 1982; October 13, 1982; November 3, 1982; November 10, 1982; November 24, 1982; February 10, 1982 executive session
coverage.note: 1982-01-06 to 1982-12-22. No minutes for the meetings of October 6, October 13, November 3, November 10 and November 24, 1982 appear in the scan; the October 20 minutes set the 82-204 issues hearing for November 3, and the December 1 minutes cite a November 24 meeting from which V82-192 was continued. The February 10, 1982 executive session is mentioned but has no minutes block. The February 3 meeting heading is misprinted February 5 in the OCR; dated February 3 on internal evidence (continuances to February 3, rehearings of January 27 items). The site inspection for 82-147 (3358 Washington Street) has no date printed. The December 22 site-inspection heading misprints the appeal number as 82-204; the inspection was for 82-261 at 30 Miller Place. No rows were recorded for appeals with no building address at all (V81-305, 82-043, 82-103, 82-194, 82-197, the plumbing permit appeal 82-185, and the two October 20 jurisdiction requests), for peddler, pushcart, taxicab, street-artist and loudspeaker-vehicle appeals, or for appeal 82-273, whose tow-car operator permit was denied on the basis of the appellant's police record. Appeal 82-068 was continued on May 12 and is not seen decided again in this volume. Appeal 82-078 was verified against the OCR: the May 26 minutes print it as the penalty for work done at 548 Fourth Street. The May 12 minutes give the NILES GROCERY address as 2201 Geneva Avenue; the May 26 rehearing minutes give it as 2200 Bayshore Boulevard; both recorded as printed. Appeal 82-245 is printed twice for two different appeals (601 Brunswick Street on November 16 and 1724 Haight Street on November 17); both recorded as printed. Appeal 82-108 is likewise printed twice (January 20 and June 9); both recorded as printed. The November 16 jurisdiction item prints the Maye Tom property as 1874 Eighth Avenue; the December 1 penalty appeal 82-258 prints the same Plumbing Charge No. 25497 at 1874-48th Avenue; both recorded as printed. The March 10 minutes state the February 17 vote on 82-025 (397 Mullen) was 4-1 to concur; the February 17 minutes print it as unanimous; both recorded as printed.
